description_en: Configures the settings for back-to-origin persistent connections for a domain name
description_zh: 配置域名回源长连接设置
name: ConfigL7UsKeepalive

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The settings for back-to-origin persistent connections. The value is a string that consists of a JSON struct. The JSON struct contains the following fields:

enabled: the switch for back-to-origin persistent connections. This field is required, and the value is of the Boolean type.
keepalive_requests: the number of requests that reuse a persistent connection. This field is required, and the value is of the integer type.
keepalive_timeout: the timeout period for an idle persistent connection. This field is required, and the value is of the integer type
parameters.help_zh:
高防回源长连接设置参数，使用JSON结构体转化的字符串格式表示，JSON结构体包含以下字段：

enabled：Boolean类型 | 必选 | 回源长连接配置开关。
keepalive_requests：Integer类型 | 必选 | 长连接复用的请求数量。
keepalive_timeout：Integer类型 | 必选 | 长连接的空闲超时时间
parameters.name: upstream_keepalive

parameters.help_zh: 客户端跟高防长连接的空闲超时时间
